newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Monday, supported by higher Chicago Board of Trade grain and oilseed prices, dealers said.
It was quiet but prices have a firmer tone because of the run-up in grains futures, a St Louis dealer said.
He also noted that feed business was slightly better than last week.
In the northeast U.S., a Buffalo dealer said demand was steady to slightly higher.
However, in southern areas, animals were eating less due to hot weather, a North Carolina broker said.

"People are waiting to see if there is any effect of a strong Chicago market," the Buffalo dealer said. "But as far as business is concerned, it may be a little bit better than a week or two ago. We are seeing some of the pastures certainly drier," he said, referring to the need in some areas for supplemental feeding.
Several dealers said for now, some buyers and sellers were waiting on the sidelines as they eyed the CBOT board's volatility.
